load_smape_metric: load the smape metric module using evaluate.load("smape")
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the smape metric using launch_gradio_widget(module)
test_smape_metric: test the smape metric by loading it with evaluate.load and computing predictions against references
run_smape_evaluation: run a smape evaluation by loading the metric and calling compute with predictions and references
review_smape_metric: review the smape metric module loaded via evaluate.load for mean absolute percentage error calculation
